result.answer: The history of record is held by the demo patient records system (/records/api), which Shutter reaches through the Records Out connection. The site profile lists that system as the one that keeps the history of record, and the system itself reports that it keeps a movement history. Its record for this stay shows the admission to WARD-A at 09:00 UTC and the transfer to WARD-C at 09:45 UTC. It is missing the transfer to WARD-B at 09:20 UTC, because that delivery failed when the system was unavailable. The patient has already moved on to WARD-C, so Shutter did not resend the failed message. Resending it could move the patient back to WARD-B. Because this system is the history of record, Shutter passed the case to a person. That person should get approval, then have the records team add the WARD-B move at its own time and leave the current WARD-C placement as it is. If the site had listed this system as holding only the patient's current location, this case would have been closed with nothing to send.
